PORTFOLIO Unparalleled range. Beloved brands. At the heart of our hospitality ecosystem is the industry’s richest portfolio of brands: 45+ leading hotel brands tailored to evolving ways of traveling, working, and living. We have built global prominence and market leadership with our Premium, Midscale & Economy brand powerhouse and our curated Luxury & Lifestyle brand collection, designed to meet the expectations and needs of all types of guests. Unrivaled Portfolio With 5,800 hotels in 110+ countries, our portfolio of 45+ iconic and beloved brands is unparalleled, spanning geographies and segments to attract a wide range of travelers. Innovative Expansion We take the lead, accelerating in growing market spaces with an ever-evolving hospitality offering including branded residential and mixed use, all-inclusive resorts, extended stay, and more. Powerful Ecosystem Our hotel brands are at the core of a unique ecosystem of services and hospitality experiences with ALL Accor – our booking platform and loyalty program – as its gateway.
